_warning: BENCH TEST ONLY: DISCONNECT THE FSM/MIRROR INPUT and connect a scope or high-impedance meter to DAC_VOUT_A. This intentionally commands approximately +-7 V. Confirm AVDD/AVSS are at least +11.5/-11.5 V under load before running; the present +-12 V rails have little margin.
_purpose: Exercise runtime DACRANGE changes end to end. A slow +-7 V sine must produce the ladder +-5 -> +-6 -> +-10 while rising and narrow back after the command returns inside 80% of a smaller range. The terminal log prints every transition. The test ends after about 10 seconds.
